profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer in Test at Broadcom Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer in Test (Symantec Enterprise Division)
profile.summary: I have 18+ years of Software Test Experience with expertise in developing test plans, writing test cases and test automation for standalone and web-based applications on Windows and Linux. I’m also proficient in programming in Java, C/C++ and Perl. I am looking for a challenging position in software test engineering.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer in Test (Symantec Enterprise Division)
Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Automated and maintained tests for customer facing web based applications in Selenium(Selenide) using Java, TestNG, Gradle, Git and Oracle/Postgres and Eclipse
	•	Set up jobs on Jenkins for running automated tests on nightly and weekly basis.
	•	Automated and tested REST APIs for User Web Services
	•	Performed manual and automated tests during product release cycles
	•	Filed and verified defects using Jira tracking system
	•	Set up and maintained virtual machines in Nutanix

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
positions.description:
•	Work in Roles & Permission Agile scrum team to test user management and time tracking functionalities for a web based application QuickBooks Online.
•	 Designed, developed and implemented manual and automated tests using internal automation framework called TrinityJS using technologies such as: Selenium WebDriver IO, Javascript, Mocha, Node.js and Jenkins.
•	Took on small size user stories to fix CSS issues
•	Had opportunity to participate in a backend Banking services project where I automated 134 integration tests for REST APIs using REST Assured, TESTNG and Java.
•	Additional tools used include Jira for user stories and defect management, IntelliJ for development environment, and QuickBase for test cases.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Perform both manual and automated tests on various web-based applications (financial and non-financial) for an online retailer in Salt Lake City, Utah.   
•	Designed, developed and implemented test automation using Selenium Web Driver written in Java for Partner Integration Tool using development tools such as: TestNG, IntelliJ, Maven, Jenkins, Subversion (source management tool), and TestLink (test management tool).   
•	Created and executed SQL queries for both manual and automated data validation using Oracle SQL Developer, SQL Plus and Java.
•	Filed and verified bug reports using Jira bug tracking system.
•	Worked with developers to resolve issues.

positions.title: Windows QA Engineer
positions.description: •	Worked at Cisco installing Windows XP and Windows 7 and tested Cisco software packages before deployment to engineering platforms

positions.title: Technical Test Lead
positions.description:
•	Worked with test engineer at Intel Corporation to help define, develop and drive the validation efforts to test internal web-based application and web services
•	Developed, created and executed functional test cases for web based application using HP Quality Center
•	Tested web services using SoapUI with test data contained in excel spreadsheet
•	Filed bug reports in HP Quality Center

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed execution, review and validation of software for medical device in FDA regulated environment at Abbott Diabetes Care on both Windows and Mac OS X
•	Performed review of test cases and suggested improvements

positions.title: Sofware Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Work closely with developers, testers, integration engineers, information developers, release managers, marketing engineers and customer support representatives in a fast-paced software development environment driven by external releases to customers.
• Develop and execute test plans to validate Intel® C++ Compiler application on multiple Windows* operating systems (written in C++) for IA-32, Intel® 64 and IA-64 architectures.
• Install and test Intel® C++ Compiler Integration on multiple Microsoft Visual Studio versions and editions: MS VS .Net 2003, MS VS 2005, MS VS 2008, MS VS 2010
• File and verify bug reports using PVCS tracker system and ClearQuest.
• Maintain, design and develop test automation scripts and test tools using AutoIt (language similar to Visual Basic) running on Windows.
• Install and maintain various Windows systems to be used during testing.
• Perform inspection for web pages of the posted product for every release to make sure the product posted are accessible to customers to download and its description is accurate and correct.
• Improve test coverage by performing quarterly bug escape analysis.
• Maintain and update test automation framework for running compiler options testing
• Automated tests on Windows to install, compile and uninstall compilers using an existing automation framework

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Test software for medical equipment written in Visual C++
•	Write and execute architecture validation plan and procedures to validate the software architecture of the product
•	Verify the function flow of the design software by putting breakpoints inside functions and monitor order of function calls  
•	Coordinate test execution process and report execution results
•	File and verify bug reports using StarTeam bug tracking system

positions.title: Software QA Analyst
positions.locationName: Department of Defense in Seaside, CA
positions.description:
•	Test web-based applications for health care management system written in Java
•	Write and execute SQL for data queries and verification using SQL Plus
•	File and verify bug reports using internal bug tracking system
•	Design, write and update test cases and procedures

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Testing software and web-based applications called “Virtual Shopping Mall” for the STB. 
•	Configure and test embedded software in the STB including connecting the STB to the TV and performing functional tests  
•	Design and execute test plan and test cases
•	Use SQL Plus to write and execute SQL for data queries and verification
•	Setting up test equipments and system including installing Linux, installing and setting up application server using JBoss, Oracle Database, static and dynamic IP configuration, NFS and Samba
•	File bug reports using Bugzilla tracking system.
•	Have designed and implemented test automation for windows application using AutoIt.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design test procedures for testing Intel Threading Tools software
•	Design and implement test automation scripts using AutoIt and Expect
•	Install and test threading tool software on various platforms including Microsoft Windows 2000, Windows XP Professional, Windows Server 2003 and Linux

positions.title: Software QC Engineer
positions.description:
•	Generated software test plans for a Semiconductor Wafer Inspection Machine
•	Participated in test plan peer review processes
•	Installed software builds on inspector machine
•	Used WinRunner to automate test execution on simulator
•	Performed manual tests on inspector machine
•	Filed software bug reports using iNotion bug tracking system and verify bug fixes
•	Designed, executed and maintained regression tests

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
•	Participated in software development life cycles
•	Designed and documented test plans and test procedures
•	Maintained and executed test cases and procedures for machine control software
•	Executed test procedures on QNX 4.2 (a variety of Unix)
•	Used SMARTS Software on Windows NT 4.0 to generate test failure reports
